metadata.title: Urban Automotive Portrait with Beveled Typography

retrievalProfile.description: A low-angle portrait of a man in a leather jacket inside a car, featuring heavy 3D metallic beveled typography and a large numerical graphic in the foreground.
triggerTerms: man in leather jacket driving car
excludeWhen: outdoor natural landscapes are the focus

recipe.visualDefinition: A cinematic, low-angle shot of a male subject seated in a car's driver seat, wearing a black leather jacket. The foreground is dominated by large, extruded 3D metallic sans-serif lettering and a vibrant red numerical character with a glossy finish.
coreVisualRelationships: Subject framed by the car interior and steering wheel
Large 3D typography anchored to the bottom third
Numerical graphic layered behind and through the main text
Warm interior lighting contrasting with dark leather textures
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up at the driver
Heavy 3D beveling on all foreground text elements

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Subject is positioned in the upper two-thirds, medium shot from the waist up.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The large metallic 3D text block at the bottom center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the subject's face, move down the leather jacket to the large red number, and finish on the metallic horizontal text.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Dark shadows in the car interior provide negative space around the subject's head.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep blacks and browns from the leather and car interior.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Metallic silver/grey of the primary typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Vibrant glossy red for the numerical graphic.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: High value contrast between the bright metallic text and the dark, moody background.

letterConstructionRules: Deep 3D extrusion with vertical light source
characterSpecificRedesigns: Numerical character features a thick red stroke and glossy 3D beveling
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: A large, glossy red 3D number acts as a secondary display element behind the main metallic text.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the necessary weight and condensed structure for the 3D effect.
Strong vertical presence suitable for heavy extrusion.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a low-angle photo of a man in a black leather jacket sitting in the driver's seat of a car with warm interior lighting.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add large 3D metallic beveled uppercase text across the bottom, with a large glossy red 3D number partially behind it.

verificationChecks: Is the text heavily beveled and metallic?
Is the subject wearing a leather jacket?
Is the perspective a low-angle interior shot?
Is there a large red numerical element?

mustRedesign: Specific facial features of the subject
postGenerationChecks: Confirm red numerical element is present
recipe.reuseFormula: Urban Portrait + Leather Texture + 3D Metallic Typography + Low Angle Framing
